displayAddress: Trafalgar Court, 14 Craigie Drive, Plymouth, Devon
description:
A characterful home with a private entrance, open-plan kitchen, dining and living space, high ceilings and sash-style windows. Ideally placed for first-time buyers and investors, with waterfront amenities and transport links within easy reach. 

Offering an appealing combination of characterful surroundings and contemporary open-plan living, this home presents an excellent opportunity for first-time buyers and investors. Positioned at ground-floor level and benefiting from its own private entrance, the accommodation also provides immediate access to the grounds outside.

At the heart of the home is an open-plan kitchen, dining and living area, creating a versatile setting for everyday living and entertaining. The kitchen incorporates fitted cabinetry, work surfaces, an integrated oven and hob, while the adjoining dining and sitting areas flow naturally together. High ceilings and sash-style windows add character to the accommodation, with supplementary internal glazing fitted to the windows to assist with insulation.

The hallway provides access to the sleeping accommodation, with fitted storage to the principal room. There is also a tiled shower room comprising a walk-in shower enclosure, wash basin and WC. 

The location places a varied selection of leisure and everyday amenities within reach. Royal William Yard is a notable nearby destination, offering restaurants, cafes, independent businesses and attractive waterfront surroundings, together with access to the South West Coast Path. Ferry connections are also available from the area towards the Barbican and Saltash.

For those considering local education, schools in the wider area include St George's CofE Primary Academy, High Street Primary Academy and Mount Wise Community Primary School, with Millbay Academy and Devonport High School for Boys amongst the secondary education options. Prospective purchasers are advised to make their own enquiries regarding school admissions and catchment arrangements.

Transport links cater for journeys both locally and further afield. Plymouth railway station provides mainline rail connections, including services towards London, while local bus routes serve Stonehouse, the city centre and surrounding districts. For motorists, the A38 provides access to the wider regional road network. Nearby destinations include Saltash, Ivybridge and Tavistock, with Exeter accessible further afield.

With its private entrance, open-plan arrangement, high ceilings, sash-style windows and position within reach of waterfront attractions and transport connections, this is an interesting opportunity for buyers seeking a distinctive home or investment.

The seller has advised that the property can be sold with furniture included or with the furniture removed, providing flexibility for the incoming purchaser.

Early viewing is strongly recommended to appreciate the accommodation and setting on offer. Enquire at the earliest convenience to arrange your viewing and ensure this opportunity is not missed.

Following the payment of the above amount, Springbok Properties will facilitate a fixed exclusivity period (approximately 12 weeks).
